property_summary: Only the admin (the deployer of C) can successfully call setOwner; any call from InvMutTest should revert and not change owner.
Calling setOwner when it returns successfully updates owner to the provided address and returns true; if it reverts the owner remains unchanged.

After any call to setOwner (whether it reverts or succeeds), the public owner getter either equals the provided address when the call succeeded, or remains equal to its previous value when the call reverted.
Calling setOwner does not change contract C's ether balance (address(c).balance) for any input and any revert/success outcome.
